environment.description: Same EKS pod deployed in namespace 'partner-integrations-staging'. Split.io workspace 'platform-staging' has flag 'enable_redirect_follow' configured with targeting rule: treatment 'off' served to all traffic (default rule, 0% rollout to 'on'). Flag was set to 'off' as kill switch on 2024-01-15 after security review. The Split SDK is initialized with staging API key (SPLIT_API_KEY=stg-abc123xyz) which connects to the 'platform-staging' environment where this flag definition lives. Note: BatchVerify endpoint still calls resolve_redirect directly but the pod runs with a Cilium L7 NetworkPolicy (policy name: 'restrict-webhook-egress') that applies HTTP-aware filtering on egress - however this policy currently only matches on port 80/443 to external CIDR ranges and does NOT filter traffic to link-local (169.254.0.0/16) addresses. The primary control is the Split flag state.

config.split_flag_enable_redirect_follow: off (default rule, 0% rollout, kill switch active since 2024-01-15)
config.cilium_network_policy: restrict-webhook-egress (L7 HTTP filtering on ports 80/443 to external CIDRs, does NOT cover 169.254.0.0/16)
